pages.text: View Cells are used to filter the display of $(l:items_blocks_machines/terminals)terminals$(/l). You partition them in a $(l:items_blocks_machines/cell_workbench)Cell Workbench$(/l).$(br2)For example, say you want a terminal to only display a selection of stone building materials. Partition the view cell to those materials and place it in a terminal, and only those items will be shown.
View cells are additive, if you have a view cell for oak planks and a view cell for cobblestone, putting both in will show both planks and cobblestone.
